settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure NoteFast options. Local-first; database backups, Markdown archive and AI are all optional.

imageUpload.description: Images are always stored locally first. With “Auto-upload”, each upload also asynchronously invokes an external command (PicGo / upgit / picfast CLI / any script) to push the image to a hosting service; failures fall back to local storage without affecting editing.
imageUpload.modeAutoHint: Local storage + async upload, falls back on failure
imageUpload.commandHint: Executable name (on PATH) or absolute path; the image path is appended as the last argument
imageUpload.contractHint: Images stay stored locally and render reliably inside the app; after a successful upload, the hosted URL is used only when exporting or sharing a document.

termDict.title: Entity Dictionary
termDict.helpTip: Declared alias → canonical-name rules: extraction, retrieval and merging all converge on the canonical name; industry term packs can be imported wholesale
termDict.description: Declare canonical-name ↔ alias rules (e.g. wafer ↔ 晶圆). New extractions converge on the canonical entity after saving; existing entities are merged immediately; searching any alias hits documents using the canonical name. An empty dictionary changes nothing.
